WITH joined AS (
  SELECT ab.*, tr.ordertypedist
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as behaviour_count
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
),
with_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    behaviour_count,
    SUM(behaviour_count) OVER () as total_count,
    CAST(behaviour_count AS FLOAT) / SUM(behaviour_count) OVER () as share
  FROM grouped
),
baseline_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as baseline_share
  FROM with_totals
)
SELECT 
  t.ordertypedist,
  t.behaviour_count,
  t.share,
  t.share - b.baseline_share as above_baseline
FROM with_totals t
CROSS JOIN baseline_calc b
WHERE t.share > b.baseline_share
ORDER BY t.ordertypedist
